newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values edge higher.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn values edge higher.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn basis values edged one to two cents per bushel higher for March shipment largely because of shipping problems on the Illinois River due to high water, grain dealers said.
Soybean and winter wheat values were mostly unchanged in light dealings, grain dealers said.
Taiwan was scheduled to tender overnight for 108,000 tonnes of U.S. or Argentine corn and 54,000 tonnes of U.S. soybeans, U.S. exporters said.
